# cairn setup claude-code

Register Cairn as a Claude Code stdio MCP server

## Help

```text
Register Cairn as a Claude Code stdio MCP server

Usage: cairn setup claude-code [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  remove  Remove the Cairn MCP server from Claude Code config
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --scope <SCOPE>
          Claude Code config scope: local or project

          Possible values:
          - local:   Register in the user's `~/.claude.json` for one project path
          - project: Register in the project's `.mcp.json`

          [default: local]

      --vault <NAME_OR_PATH>
          Active vault: name from registry or filesystem path (overrides CAIRN_VAULT)

      --project-dir <PATH>
          Project directory used for local/project Claude Code config

      --home-dir <PATH>
          Home directory used for local Claude Code config

      --server-name <NAME>
          Claude Code MCP server name to configure

          [default: cairn]

      --json
          Emit JSON receipt instead of human-readable output

      --binary <PATH>
          Cairn binary path to register as the MCP command

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```

## Subcommands

- [`cairn setup claude-code remove`](setup-claude-code-remove.md) - Remove the Cairn MCP server from Claude Code config
